answer: Each agent identity is registered in a TPM/SGX enclave and must produce a zero-knowledge attestation bound to a hardware key; the grove state tree commits identities, the wharf hash anchor timestamps attestations, and the lagoon consensus contract verifies them. Forging requires compromising distinct physical enclaves and sustaining valid measurements; admission follows an O(N^2) quadratic bonding curve, while fraud triggers irreversible collateral slashing.
